node.title: Re^2: Privilege reduction with start_server / plackup
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Plack is the FastCGI "glue"

[mod://Plack]/[mod://PSGI] is not FastCGI and FastCGI is only one of many ways to run [mod://Plack] apps. [mod://Twiggy], [mod://Starman], [mod://Starlet], [mod://HTTP::Server::PSGI], the [mod://Plack::Handler] subclasses...

the command-line is intended for offline testing purposes

That's plain wrong.
